description: Inspect this project now: returns documentation audit findings, committed-diff review findings, decision/map status, and a quickstart playbook. Quickstart is read-only and deterministic. Explicit mode: setup validates shared configuration and activates locally without editing shared files; mode: init explicitly prepares MCP, instructions and lifecycle hooks for review and commit. Neither runs audits or prepares repairs; use only when requested. Optional host selects codex or claude. Optional base selects the review comparison; evidence imports CI manifests with check outcomes, commit freshness, and links to changed files and accepted decisions. Repeat calls refresh findings even after setup.

base.description: Quickstart only: Git ref for committed-diff review. Defaults to the first available main branch ref.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

dryRun.description: Init only: preview shared configuration changes without writing files.

evidence.description: Quickstart only: repository-local CI evidence manifests to include in the review. Imports Vitest JSON, SARIF, and native-validator mason-check-json results without executing check commands.

host.description: Assistant to configure in init/setup mode; inferred only when unambiguous.

mode.description: Quickstart inspects without edits; init prepares shared configuration; setup activates compatible configuration locally.

name: mason_init
